sentences.text: On the Ombria-News test set, Marrowline-int8 achieves slightly lower translation quality than Selk-MT (chrF 57.9 vs 58.4), though no statistical test was reported for this difference.
Marrowline-int8 also provides substantially lower serving latency than Selk-MT, with p50 latency of 97 ms vs 186 ms and p99 latency of 610 ms vs 1,240 ms on the replayed production trace.
Marrowline-int4 shows a larger quality drop (chrF 55.2 vs 58.4) but even lower latency (p50 71 ms, p99 460 ms) compared to Selk-MT.
